Cross-link: the two server-side findings from the same sweep, filed where they land:

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#21948 — the served field def carries an undeclared `help` key; it is the cause of the ~520 `retired spelling help` warnings per page load that this card does not list.
- objectstack-ai/objectui#11691 — `/api/v1/auth/config` reports `disableSignUp: false` under `invite_only`, which is why the console offers Sign up.

## Triage: split by fix site into 17 single-scope cards and closed `completed` as their source

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-06T05:15Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Every item was re-read on objectui `main` (`848ba0e12f`) before filing, and all 17 are still live. Only three commits had landed since the sweep's pin (objectui#11668, objectstack-ai/objectstack#11670 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#11671), and none touches these files. None of the items has an open duplicate.

Update: the maintainer asked for the UX findings this card had left out to be filed as separate cards (verbatim: 「分开立 7 张」). Three entries of the "Not filed — observations" section above are now cards, and four further findings were added:

- objectstack-ai/objectui#11694 — dashboards / reports waste the first screen ("Refresh All" on its own grid row; tall empty report cards)
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#21960 — Setup → Users opens on "My Profile" (was listed above as an observation)
- objectstack-ai/objectui#11695 — delete confirm does not name the record, neutral "Continue" button
- objectstack-ai/objectui#11696 — list pages titled with the singular label (was listed above as an observation)
- objectstack-ai/objectui#11697 — raw JSON for composite / record-map values; raw user id as Audit Log Browser actor
- objectstack-ai/objectui#11698 — inbox opens on the empty Notifications tab under an approvals badge
- objectstack-ai/objectui#11699 — duplicate requests on record open (was listed above as an observation; the earlier "preference reads ×3" turned out to be three different keys, corrected there)
